items.q: An independent effect of anemia in CKD is a raised risk of:
items.exp: Effect of anemia: independent effect — risk of fall in GFR. (Book p809)

items.q: The cardiovascular-mortality branch of anemia in CKD lists which causes?
items.exp: Cardiovascular mortality (m/c cause of death) — causes: LVH, calcification, endothelial dysfunction. (Book p809)

items.exp: Causes: LVH, calcification, endothelial dysfunction. (Book p809)
